description: Create a DNS record (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, etc). Requires confirm:true (human-approval gate); without it returns a preview only.

confirm.description: Human-approval gate: must be true to actually perform this mutating operation. Omit or set false to get a non-executing preview of what would happen (with secrets redacted). A human should approve before this is set to true.

content.description: Record value (IP, target host, text, etc).

name.description: Record name (e.g. www.example.com or @ for root).

proxied.description: Whether traffic is proxied through Cloudflare (A/AAAA/CNAME only).

zone_id.description: The Cloudflare zone ID (32-char hex). Get it from list_zones.

name: create_dns_record
